rows.displayName: Bi-Lipschitz Coordinates at Regular RCD Points

claim.ja: 整数n≥2、非崩壊full RCD(K,n)、基準測度Hⁿの下で、全pointed GH tangentがRⁿの各点に周囲で開な近傍からRⁿの開集合への$L_n$-bi-Lipschitz座標。$L_n$は次元のみ依存し、距離は周囲の距離の制限。全正則点を含む全測度の開領域と可算atlasも得る。
claim.en: For integer n≥2, noncollapsed full RCD(K,n) with reference measure Hⁿ, every point whose pointed GH tangents are all Rⁿ has an ambient-open neighborhood $L_n$-bi-Lipschitz to an open subset of Rⁿ. $L_n$ depends only on n; charts use restricted ambient distance. A full-measure open region containing all regular points has a countable atlas.

role.ja: 開調和座標を作り、累積Bochner質量の行列比較と可算和可能な方向別欠損を、座標値空間の逆転置更新へ入力する。有限尺度の微分評価から全点対の上下評価と極限の開性へ進む。
role.en: Open harmonic coordinates feed cumulative matrix control of Bochner mass and summable directional defects into inverse-transpose updates in value space. Finite-scale derivative estimates then yield both distance bounds for every pair and openness of the limit.
